sources.label: 🍃 SoundCloud patches for Morphe (Enable Go, AMOLED theme, Disable analytics & co
sources.author: V4n1X
patch_list: Changes the default dark theme to use true blacks for AMOLED screens.
Disables the OneTrust consent/cookies popup and collapses banner views.
Enables SoundCloud Go+ premium features, offline listening, HQ audio, and disables audio/visual ads.
Applies Android 12+ Material You dynamic accent colors from the system wallpaper palette.

sources.label: Psylos

patch_list: Changes the default dark theme to use true blacks for AMOLED screens.
Routes SoundCloud download buttons to a configured external app using the public track or playlist URL.
Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.
Adds a setting that hides SoundCloud's Cast icon in menu and view variants.

sources.label: Morphe Patches for SoundCloud
sources.author: Hoodles
patch_list: Changes the default dark theme to use true blacks for AMOLED screens.
Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.
Allows hiding customizable sections and carousels on the SoundCloud Home feed.
Allows hiding Cast, Upload, Messages, and Notification Bell icons from the top bar.
Routes track and playlist download actions to an external downloader package.
Adds Morphe Settings menu directly into SoundCloud settings screen.
